declaration.declared_before: any Trading V1.1 development replay, forward observation, paper trade or live trade
declaration.scope: point-in-time / look-ahead correction of the 09:25 decision universe only
declaration.motivation: E-F0 audit: two post-09:25 availability tests were pre-selection universe filters in Trading V1 (the 09:30 minute bar of D and the grouped-daily open of D). Neither is knowable at 09:25, so V1 cannot be reproduced by a LIVE 09:25 decision.
declaration.not_motivated_by_performance: No performance number was computed for V1.1 and no E-D6 result was used to choose any V1.1 rule.

version_authority.alpha_contract: H5 V1, unchanged (E-D0 alpha section, canonical f1534f07688c801f2979491e447eefbb3e62b8045afb9c4ab302b90e4593d4b2)
version_authority.trading_v1: HISTORICAL; superseded for forward decision semantics
version_authority.trading_v1_1: authoritative candidate for a PIT-corrected development replay and for future Forward

alpha.statement: premarket_gap > 0 and premarket_rvol >= 3.0 and position_in_premarket_range >= 0.8 and return_0900_0925 > 0

universe.principle: every universe, feature, H5 and selection input has information_timestamp <= 09:25 ET of session D

daily.membership: ticker in the latest CS reference snapshot dated on or before D-1
daily.dollar_volume_window: median of close*volume over [D-21, D-2] (the 20 sessions before D-1)
daily.split_exclusion: no split executing in (D-1, D], read from a split list published before 09:25 ET of D
daily.removed_from_v1: E0 row requirement open(t+1) > 0 at t = D-1, i.e. that the grouped-daily open of D exists

premarket.removed_from_v1: e1_premarket_rules_v1.json requires_open_bar_0930 = true; premarket.session_rows dropped a session without an opening block; dataset.build required a finite 09:30 open

rvol_semantics.definition: premarket dollar volume of D / median of the last 20 finite positive premarket dollar volumes over prior sessions that had at least one bar in [04:00, 09:24] and a 09:30 bar; undefined with fewer than 5 such sessions
rvol_semantics.prior_session_0930_requirement_is_pit: whether an earlier session had a 09:30 bar is known at D; this history rule is kept unchanged so every V1 row keeps its exact RVOL
rvol_semantics.rules_text_discrepancy: e1_premarket_rules_v1.json words the denominator as 'the 20 prior sessions that had premarket activity' without the 09:30 clause; the code that produced every H5 result also requires the 09:30 bar. V1.1 follows the code, because the Alpha evidence was computed with it.

spy_context.spy_close_previous: SPY close(D-1) from the same grouped-daily source
spy_context.spy_premarket_last: SPY last trade at or before 09:24 ET of D; SPY's 09:30 bar is not required (V1 required it through session_rows)
spy_context.role: sealed control columns spy_premarket_return and relative_strength_vs_spy; not an H5 input

coverage.development_replay: D-1 daily-eligible symbols that have a row in the bound development tape; the tape's coverage limitation carries over unchanged from E1/E-D6
coverage.forward: the whole D-1 daily-eligible universe must have minute coverage; see the forward feature context contract

universe.identity_guarantee: for every (D, symbol) row V1 produced, V1.1 produces bit-identical feature values; V1.1 additionally admits rows whose only V1 rejection was the missing 09:30 bar of D or the missing grouped-daily open of D

pipeline.post_seal_mutation: forbidden; the entry layer must reproduce the sealed selected set exactly or the session is refused

selection.example: candidates A,B,C,D -> selected A,B,C; B has no valid 09:30 bar -> executions A,C; D is not promoted

costs.source: E-D4 (and the E-D6 GROSS_0BP diagnostic), unchanged

e_d6_v1_supersession.e_d6_v1_result: HISTORICAL RESULT PRESERVED (E-D6 INCONCLUSIVE — STATISTICAL); artifacts not modified
e_d6_v1_supersession.reason: 09:30 entry availability (and the grouped-daily open of D) affected pre-selection universe membership, so a missing 09:30 bar could silently hand its capacity slot to the next H5 symbol
e_d6_v1_supersession.consequence_in_e_d6: NO_TRADE_MISSING_ENTRY_BAR could not occur in E-D6 (0 of 501 selected); such symbols had already been removed before H5
e_d6_v1_supersession.re_evaluation: a V1.1 development replay needs its own preregistered protocol; not part of E-R1

forbidden: changing any H5 threshold, feature or inclusivity
adding an Alpha feature or ranking
changing candidate priority, capacity, entry, exit, cost or sizing
adding a stop, target, partial exit, price filter or symbol exclusion
choosing any V1.1 rule from an E-D6 result
reading any daily row dated D or later, or any minute bar starting after 09:24 ET of D, before the seal
